purpose: Bundled, offline-first classroom fixtures for CPU demonstrations

supervised_intro_lamost.source_name: ATLAS-A directly observed stellar spectra teaching subset
supervised_intro_lamost.source_note: A fixed sample of 2000 directly observed ATLAS-A spectra. Each 3800-8700 Angstrom spectrum is normalized over 5000-8000 Angstrom and rebinned from 4901 pixels to 128 flux features; Teff_sed is retained as the classroom regression target.
supervised_intro_lamost.license_note: The NADC page provides public download and a required citation, but no broader open-data license is inferred here. Cite Ji et al. 2023 and dataset DOI 10.12149/101205.

supervised_intro.source_note: 342 records with complete bill length, bill depth, flipper length, and body mass; species is retained as the classroom classification target.
supervised_intro.license_note: The palmerpenguins repository distributes the simplified dataset under CC0-1.0; cite Gorman, Williams, and Fraser (2014), PLOS ONE 9(3): e90081.

text.source_note: Public-domain literary text mirrored by the char-rnn project; used only as the language-model warm-up.
text.license_note: Public-domain source text; retain source attribution for the mirrored teaching file.

protein.source_note: First 500 reviewed entries returned by the UniProt REST query; canonical amino-acid sequences are retained for the teaching fixture.
protein.license_note: UniProt applies CC BY 4.0 to copyrightable database content; attribution is required and other rights may apply.

dna.source_note: A 450 kb teaching excerpt after the leading unsequenced region; only A/C/G/T bases are used.
dna.license_note: UCSC asks users to acknowledge data contributors and review source-specific README restrictions.

smiles.source_name: Delaney ESOL dataset distributed by DeepChem
smiles.source_note: 1128 molecular SMILES with measured aqueous-solubility labels; classroom use is a small regression-flow demonstration.
smiles.license_note: DeepChem code is MIT; no broader ESOL dataset license is inferred. Cite Delaney 2004 when using the labels.

weather.source_note: Four-frame 16x16 moving Gaussian fields with recorded motion parameters.
weather.license_note: Generated by nanoSciGPT under the repository MIT license; not observational weather data.

crystal.source_note: Small periodic cells built from documented atomic-number and fractional-coordinate prototypes.
crystal.license_note: Generated by nanoSciGPT under the repository MIT license; not a materials benchmark.

structure3d.source_note: Rigidly transformed 16-point helices with recorded pitch parameters.
structure3d.license_note: Generated by nanoSciGPT under the repository MIT license; not experimental protein structures.

image.source_note: Single-band 16x16 images containing one to four Gaussian point sources.
image.license_note: Generated by nanoSciGPT under the repository MIT license; not telescope observations.

spectrum.source_note: Normalized 128-bin Planck continua with synthetic absorption lines and recorded temperatures.
spectrum.license_note: Generated by nanoSciGPT under the repository MIT license; not observed stellar spectra.

field.source_note: Four states of a one-dimensional Fourier field with recorded diffusion coefficients.
field.license_note: Generated by nanoSciGPT under the repository MIT license; not laboratory measurements.
